title: Feathers are fuel
description: Feathers can now be used as fuel.
body:
Put those excess feathers to work! This simple quality-of-life mod allows feathers to be used as furnace fuel.

Features:

 Burn feathers directly in furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces
 
 No recipes needed—just craft and burn
 
 Fully compatible with vanilla progression

Great for survival players who hate seeing valuable resources go to waste!
